alternatives.function_family: blur_lens (cross-subtype; gaussian-vs-lens MTF indistinguishable, PSNR arbiter)

analysis.rationale: blur: gm_ratio=0.0953, spectral_slope_ratio=1.187, DT=gaussian(medium); motion (FFT anisotropy 1.93) and lens re-tested with the corrected global are worse (29.36/37.40 dB); sigma scan 3/4/5 = 37.30/37.73/36.96 dB -> gaussian:4. global: variance_ratio=0.1008 + spread_ratio=0.3076 + chroma_ratio=0.4417 + mean_shift=-7.5 cannot be fit by linear contrast_weaken_scale (chroma implies alpha~0.45, variance implies ~0.32) but is fit by nonlinear contrast_weaken_stretch (per-channel mean mapped to 127.5): residual after stripping = var 1.055, spread 1.018, chroma 1.062, mean_shift -0.1, unique_G 101 vs target 102; stretch scan 3/4/5 = 32.59/36.96/30.90 dB -> stretch:4. No JPEG (block_boundary=1.0068<1.05; adding jpeg:1 drops PSNR to 35.69 and block_boundary err 223%). No noise (sigma=1.11<2; peeled §B IMPULSE is the documented extreme_pct false positive with fully structured residual spatial_corr=0.994 and all x_distortion noise functions at sev1 far stronger than observed). No saturation (chroma ratio fully explained by the stretch; adding saturation worsens direction). Deterministic PSNR 37.73 dB (30-40 band) -> per-step and overall UNCERTAIN.
analysis.support_note: Support pairs show heterogeneous global signals (mean_shift -7.5/+26.8/+64.3; variance_ratio 0.10/0.18/0.61) consistent with the same nonlinear stretch family applied to images of different brightness; remaining pair-specific mismatch (pair4 unique_G 94 vs simulation 256) indicates per-pair severity/parameter variation in the support set. Pair 0 is the reference pair per protocol.
